known_boundary: The helper serializes its own deployments and detects an unexpected displaced inode/value after an atomic exchange. It preserves conflict files and refuses blind rollback. It does not claim a kernel content-CAS against arbitrary writers that ignore its lock.
scope: isolated Linux temporary directories using renameat2 RENAME_EXCHANGE for exchange/fault semantics; actual Mac cutover is not claimed
